# Minnesota Lawyer

> Minnesota Lawyer is a comprehensive legal news and resources platform serving Minnesota's legal community with court opinions, lawyer recognition, events, and professional development opportunities.

Minnesota Lawyer provides legal professionals with breaking news, court decisions, CLE opportunities, and industry recognition through awards like the Minnesota Legal 250 and The Power List. The platform also serves as a public notice publisher for legal announcements across Minnesota counties.

## Key Topics

- Minnesota legal news
- Court opinions
- Minnesota Supreme Court
- Minnesota Legal 250
- Legal awards and recognition
- CLE credits
- Public notices
- Legal events
- Minnesota lawyers
- Court of Appeals
- Professional development
- Legal industry
- Minneapolis legal community
- Verdict and settlement reports
- Webinars

## News & Legal Content

- [Minnesota Lawyer Homepage](https://minnlawyer.com): Homepage featuring Minnesota legal news, court cases, and lawyer appointments
- [Minnesota Lawyer Resources](https://resources.minnlawyer.com/index): Free downloadable resources including guides, webinars, and legal software
- [Webinars](https://minnlawyer.com/webinars): Webinars on trending legal topics with Minnesota legal thought leaders

## Awards & Recognition

- [Minnesota Legal 250 Nominations](https://minnlawyer.com/minnesota-legal-250-nominations): Nomination form for Minnesota Legal 250 awards recognizing legal leaders
- [Up & Coming Attorneys and Unsung Legal Heroes](https://minnlawyer.com/event/up-coming-attorneys-and-unsung-legal-heroes): Legal awards and recognition event celebrating Minnesota legal community
- [Reader Rankings](https://minnlawyer.com/reader-rankings): Annual reader rankings of trusted legal brands and business partners

## Events & Professional Development

- [Minnesota Lawyer Events](https://minnlawyer.com/minnesota-lawyer-events): Calendar of legal events and professional development for Minnesota lawyers
- [Minnesota Lawyer Calendar of Events](https://minnlawyer.com/minnesota-lawyers-calendar-of-events): Calendar of CLE credits and legal seminars for Minnesota lawyers

## Public Notices

- [Public Notices](https://minnlawyer.com/public-notice): Public notices section for legal announcements and government notices
- [Submit Public Notice](https://minnlawyer.com/submit-public-notice): Public notice submission for Ramsey County and Hennepin County publications
- [Public Notice About](https://minnlawyer.com/public-notice/about): Information about public notice advertising and submission requirements
- [Public Notice FAQ](https://minnlawyer.com/public-notice/faq): FAQ for public notice categories including bids, probate, and real estate

## Subscription & Advertising

- [Subscribe](https://minnlawyer.com/subscribe): Subscription page for Minnesota Lawyer legal news and resources
- [Sign up for our newsletters](https://minnlawyer.com/sign-up-for-our-newsletters): Newsletter signup for Minnesota legal news and court opinions
- [Advertising](https://minnlawyer.com/advertising): Advertising platform to reach Minnesota legal decision makers and leaders

## User Account & Submissions

- [User Login](https://minnlawyer.com/user-login): User authentication and account access portal for Minnesota Lawyer
- [Manage Your Email Subscriptions](https://minnlawyer.com/manage-account-em): Email subscription and account management settings for Minnesota Lawyer
- [Submit a Verdict & Settlement Report](https://minnlawyer.com/submit-a-verdict-settlement-report): Form to submit verdicts and settlements for publication in Minnesota Lawyer
- [Behind the Deal Submissions](https://minnlawyer.com/behind-the-deal-submissions): Submission form for mergers, acquisitions, and deal announcements
